title: Built an AI game maker that actually works - 70+ users with zero marketing - who join?
author: Horror-Apprehensive
selftext:
Update: Made a platform where you describe a game and AI builds it for you. Already have 70+ users creating 100+ games (space shooters, snake games, etc.) with just 3-4 organic posts.

Built with React/TypeScript but want to add multiplayer, leaderboards, and support for complex games.

Looking for partners to help build or fund the next version. DM if interested.

comments.author: Fine-Presentation-53
comments.body: That's pretty impressive progress with your AI game maker! Seems like it's really tapped into a niche demand, especially managing that with minimal marketing. I had a similar experience when I used Tesana; described a basic layout for a space-themed platformer and the platform converted it into a 3D space shooter. Got it from Tesana, and it was less fragile than I anticipated which really helped solidify my early concepts without much hassle. It’s cool to see more tools emerging that democratize game development, making it more accessible to everyone. Keep up the great work expanding your platform’s capabilities!
